news.title: Pune E - Stock Broking Limited to Report Second Half, 2026 Results on May 13, 2026
news.body: Pune E - Stock Broking Limited announced that they will report second half, 2026 results on May 13, 2026

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.8% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk High level of non-cash earnings (60% accrual ratio). news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 20%
news.body: After last week's 20% share price gain to ₹281, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 31.8x. Average trailing P/E is 24x in the Capital Markets industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 96% over the past year.

news.title: Pune E - Stock Broking Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 93.6 million in funding
news.body: Pune E - Stock Broking Limited announces a private placement with Vraj Enterprises, Arpit Sandip Shah, Sejal Paresh Shah, RSP Capital Advisors Private Limited to issue 1,600,000 Convertible Warrants at a price of INR 58.5 per warrant for gross proceeds of INR 93,600,000 on February 16, 2026. Warrant Exercise price is INR 175.5. Considered and approved that the Extra Ordinary General Meeting (“EGM”) of the Company be held on 13th March 2026 at 12:00 P.M through Video Conferencing / other Audio-Visual means
